notes.title: May 7, 25 (Enemy Unit data revised)
notes.notes:
The attack power and health of some enemy units in the second stage (Goblin Tunnel) have been modified.

Ogre - Decreased attack power, greatly increased HP
Goblin Rider_Attack power reduced
Orc (two-handed axe) _Decreased attack power, increased HP
Orc (Mace) _Decreased attack power, increased HP
